name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through her passion for data analysis during her business degree at McGill University. She recognized the potential of leveraging data to enhance marketing strategies, a concept she honed during internships at a local advertising agency. This led her to pursue opportunities within the motorsports industry, starting with smaller racing teams before eventually finding her place at RSC Motorsport. 

At RSC Motorsport, Isabelle's methodical approach and calm demeanor are invaluable assets. She excels at developing comprehensive marketing campaigns, meticulously tracking their performance, and adapting strategies based on real-time data. Her focus on clear communication and collaborative teamwork ensures that marketing initiatives are well-aligned with the team's overall goals. What sets Isabelle apart is her ability to blend analytical insights with creative storytelling, crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike.

Outside the marketing world, Isabelle is a passionate advocate for STEM education, volunteering her time at local schools to inspire young girls to pursue careers in science and technology. She also enjoys hiking in the Canadian Rockies, using her time in nature to reflect and generate new ideas.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back into a low ponytail
physical.description: Isabelle is of average height with a warm smile and a practical, no-nonsense appearance.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized planner open on her desk.
Insists on starting every meeting with a brief recap of the previous one.
